description:
Mix and match hundreds of parts to create a desktop pet that's uniquely yours

Standing Mode: Just stands there... though it does wander around from time to time;
Sit-in-a-Row Mode: Keeps you company while you work, syncing with every keystroke;
Hiding in the Corner: Lurking at the edge of your screen, watching over you quietly without getting in the way!

Rich animations and expressions let every character show off their own personality

Earn rewards even while AFK! Pull, craft, and collect accessories — experiment with all kinds of outfits!

Now, bring your character home.
short_description: Character House: Desktop Companion is an idle collection game. Mix and match parts to create a companion that sits with you as you work, syncing with keystrokes, or watches from a corner. Earn rewards offline: pull and craft accessories,, shape its personality, and visit friends online!
requirements:
Минимальные:
64-разрядные процессор и операционная система

ОС: Windows 10

Процессор: Intel Core i3/AMD equivalent

Оперативная память: 4096 MB ОЗУ

Видеокарта: DirectorX 11 compatible GPU

DirectX: версии 11

Сеть: Широкополосное подключение к интернету

Место на диске: 512 MB

Звуковая карта: DirectorX compatible
